Subject: POC prompt dataset & eval plan  next steps

Hi Alex  great conversation this morning, thanks for taking the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your POC scoped and scheduled: 

1) Success criteria (what Stellar Retail told us you care about):
- Response relevance/accuracy for user support snippets  target NPS uplift +10 points or precision >= 85% on our eval set
- Latency at 95th percentile <= 400ms for single-turn queries at your expected traffic (avg 50 RPS burst to 150 RPS)
- Cost target: approx <= $0.002/token for production profile (we'll optimize with batching/quantization)

2) Evaluation plan (high level):
- You provide a representative prompt set + anonymized historical logs (customer support Q/As) -> we build an eval dataset
- Redwood runs a baseline on an open model variant and a tuned quantized variant, returns accuracy metrics, latency, token costs, and failure modes
- Joint review and iterate on prompts / prompts-to-prompts guarded cases

3) Timeline / owners:
- 6/12: Redwood (Aditya) to share a short eval plan template and example metrics spreadsheet (attached: poc_eval_template.xlsx)
- 6/14: Stellar to deliver sample prompts + 1 week of anonymized logs (CSV) and any domain-specific scoring rubric
- Week of 6/15: Technical kickoff + initial run of eval
- 4-week POC period thereafter with weekly syncs (Marissa to own commercial cadence)

4) Asks for your team now:
- Export 200-500 representative prompts/responses (CSV) and one week of anonymized logs showing query volume/typical sequence lengths
- Any internal rubric or examples of acceptable/ unacceptable outputs
- Point of contact for technical data transfer (SFTP/Drive)

I attached a short checklist and an example prompt CSV to make this painless. Let us know if these timelines look OK and if you prefer a different data transfer method.

Thanks  I can take care of scheduling the kickoff once we have the dataset.

Best,
Marissa

Alex/Marissa  thanks. Quick technical notes and plan (summary):

1) Dataset requirements (for meaningful eval):
- 300-500 representative prompts + gold responses (if available). CSV columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, context, expected_response, category, priority
- 1 week of anonymized logs (fields: timestamp, prompt_text, response_text, token_count, user_session_length)  replay works well for latency/throughput profiling

2) PII / redaction:
- We can accept anonymized logs. We recommend a short redaction checklist: remove direct identifiers (email, phone, full names), replace with placeholders (e.g., [PERSON], [EMAIL]); retain domain-specific tokens where possible. I attached a short redaction example and the eval template (poc_eval_template.xlsx).

3) Traffic / latency testing:
- Replay of your logs is preferred for representative tail-latency testing. For stress testing higher bursts, we can generate synthetic traffic based on observed inter-arrival times; let us know if you want us to run both.

4) Evaluation metrics we will produce:
- Precision/Recall and a simple relevance score (0-1) vs provided golds; top-k accuracy; latency P50/P95/P99; cost-per-1k-tokens; failure-mode examples and recommended prompt fixes

5) Next steps and owners:
- Aditya: deliver full eval plan + redaction checklist by EOD 6/12 (attached: poc_eval_template.xlsx)
- Alex: upload dataset to SFTP or Drive by 6/14 (Stellar Retail)
- Marissa: schedule week-of-6/15 kickoff once dataset is uploaded

Happy to jump on a quick 30-min technical sync if Priya wants to run through the redaction/export.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
